newsitem.title: USA: Finish Line Q4 Mar 1 net up on sales gain.
newsitem.headline: Finish Line Q4 Mar 1 net up on sales gain.

text.p: Finish Line Inc said Monday infrastructure improvements and higher sales helped earnings climb to record levels in the fourth quarter ended March 1.
The company reported net income of $6.7 million, or $0.26 a share, up from $3.6 million, or $0.17, a year ago. Sales in the period rose to $96.2 million from $70.6 million, Finish Line said.
The retailer added its sales are growing as it also sees significant decreases in inventory on a per square foot basis.
Finish Line sells athletic and lifestyle footwear, activewear and accessories.
Its shares were off 1-1/4 Monday at 22-1/4.
